topic: 5 Shopify product page fixes that lift conversion rate

slides.title: Your product page is leaking sales
slides.body: 5 fixes to check on yours today.

slides.title: Keep the buy button in reach on mobile
slides.body: Shoppers should not hunt for it. A sticky add to cart keeps the action one tap away.

slides.title: Show proof next to the button
slides.body: Ratings and short reviews near add to cart build trust right at the moment of decision.

slides.title: Answer shipping questions early
slides.body: State delivery and returns info under the button. It removes last-second doubt.

slides.title: Use images that actually sell
slides.body: Mix lifestyle photos, a close-up and a size reference. Show the product in use.

slides.title: Lazy load below-the-fold images
slides.body: Keep the first image eager and lazy load the rest so the page loads faster.

topic: Why your Shopify store has traffic but no sales (CRO checklist)

slides.title: Traffic but no sales?
slides.body: Check these 5 things before buying more ads.

slides.title: Match the ad to the landing page
slides.body: If the ad promises a deal, the page must show it right away. A mismatch makes people leave.

slides.title: Fix your mobile layout first
slides.body: Much of your traffic is on phones. Test tap targets, text size and the cart flow on a real device.

slides.title: Cut the clutter on product pages
slides.body: One clear action beats ten options. Remove popups and banners that compete with add to cart.

slides.title: Speed up the page
slides.body: Slow pages lose buyers. Remove unused apps and compress images before changing anything else.

slides.title: Make checkout feel safe
slides.body: Show payment icons, return info and a support contact near the cart and checkout.

topic: 5 WordPress speed fixes that actually move Core Web Vitals

slides.title: Slow WordPress site?
slides.body: 5 fixes that help Core Web Vitals.

slides.title: Start with decent hosting
slides.body: Weak hosting caps your speed. Check server response time before tweaking anything else.

slides.title: Turn on page caching
slides.body: Caching serves ready-made HTML instead of rebuilding every page on each visit.

lines: // Let your cache plugin take over

slides.title: Compress and resize images
slides.body: Serve WebP at the displayed size. Oversized images are a very common cause of slow pages.

slides.title: Remove plugins you don't use
slides.body: Every plugin can add scripts and queries. Delete unused ones instead of only deactivating them.

slides.title: Defer non-critical scripts
slides.body: Load chat widgets and trackers after the page is usable, so the main content shows first.

topic: Shopify add-to-cart button: 5 changes that increase clicks

slides.title: Small button changes, more clicks
slides.body: 5 things to test on your add to cart.

slides.title: Make it the clearest thing on the page
slides.body: Use a high-contrast color no other element uses. The eye should land on it first.

slides.title: Use specific button text
slides.body: Add a clear price or state to the label and test it against your current text.

slides.title: Make it easy to tap on mobile
slides.body: Use a full-width button with plenty of space around it so it is easy to hit with a thumb.

slides.title: Add reassurance right under it
slides.body: Small trust lines under the button reduce hesitation at the moment of the click.

slides.title: Keep it visible while scrolling
slides.body: A sticky button on mobile keeps the action one tap away on long product pages.
